business_rules.name: Verified tenant context
business_rules.description: Every governed operation requires verified tenant context before data access.

business_rules.name: Deny by default
business_rules.description: Authorization returns deny when no explicit allow applies.

business_rules.name: Idempotent mutation
business_rules.description: Externally retried mutations require an idempotency key and stable result.

business_rules.name: Immutable identifier
business_rules.description: A governed record identifier cannot be changed after creation.

business_rules.name: Canonical UTC storage
business_rules.description: System timestamps are stored in UTC.
business_rules.action: Convert to UTC and retain source timezone where material

business_rules.name: Permission-aware search
business_rules.description: Search returns only documents authorized at query time.

business_rules.name: File version immutability
business_rules.description: Uploaded file versions are immutable after acceptance.

business_rules.name: At-least-once event handling
business_rules.description: Consumers must tolerate duplicate event delivery.

business_rules.name: Dead-letter preservation
business_rules.description: Permanently failed events and jobs move to a dead-letter store with evidence.

business_rules.name: Feature flag safety
business_rules.description: Disabling a feature cannot destroy governed data.
business_rules.action: Block new use and preserve history

business_rules.name: Offline scope minimum
business_rules.description: Offline packs contain only required records and fields for assigned work.

business_rules.name: Deterministic conflict policy
business_rules.description: Sync conflicts use declared field or entity policy.

business_rules.name: No secrets in logs
business_rules.description: Secrets, tokens, and prohibited fields must be redacted before logging.

business_rules.name: Explicit unit conversion
business_rules.description: Cross-unit arithmetic requires a governed conversion.
business_rules.action: Convert using registered conversion and precision

business_rules.name: Explicit currency conversion
business_rules.description: Cross-currency arithmetic requires rate, source, and effective date.

business_rules.name: AI gateway enforcement
business_rules.description: Production AI calls may not bypass the model gateway.

business_rules.name: Registered agent only
business_rules.description: Only active evaluated agents may execute production tools.

business_rules.name: Tool permission inheritance
business_rules.description: AI tool permissions cannot exceed the invoking context and agent grants.
business_rules.inputs: user context, agent grants, tool request
business_rules.exception: Break-glass not allowed for autonomous action

business_rules.name: Evidence required for material AI output
business_rules.description: Material AI recommendations require source evidence and model/prompt version.

business_rules.name: Restore verification
business_rules.description: A backup is not considered valid until a restoration test succeeds.
